title: Amy Reynolds taken and found at a petrol station 790 km away
place_text: petrol station 790 km from where she was taken

tellings.quote: Amy ryance is probably one of my favorite cases in this regard because she was taken her friend Petra watched her being taken through the window all of a sudden they get this call that she's been found at a petrol station 790 km away

plain: A woman named Amy Reynolds was taken while her friend, a woman named Petra, watched it happen through a window, and soon afterwards the friends got a call saying Amy had been found at a petrol station 790 kilometres away. The researcher Mike Masters tells it on Jesse Michels's show as one of his favourite cases, summarising it without naming a source. If true, it would mean someone was moved a huge distance in a very short time.
